intro:
Where will the next case unfold?
Find the hidden clue!
description:
Ready to feel like a detective in a simple, easy-to-pick-up mystery game?

An everyday scene can turn into a case in an instant.
One room, one incident, and clues hidden in plain sight.

Your job is to study the scene, find the evidence, and uncover the truth.

Each case is a short, self-contained story, so you can jump in anytime, even with no mystery game experience.

How to play:
・Read the situation and question
・Examine the illustration carefully
・Find the suspicious evidence in the scene
・Use the hint if you get stuck

The hints help guide your deduction, making it fun for first-time sleuths and puzzle fans alike.

Take a look around the room and see if you can crack the case!
